recording.note: Hand-written to look like real model output. Planted: TC-08 quotes an AC 3 that does not exist in the story (24 hours, three uses); TC-18 invents a 2-minute target for the vague AC 7.

cases.title: Forgot password link opens the reset form
preconditions: User is signed out
cases.expected: A form opens with a single field for the account email address.

ac_quotes.text: The sign-in page has a "Forgot password?" link that opens a form asking for the account email address.

cases.title: Registered email gets the generic message and a reset email
preconditions: An account exists for anna@example.com
cases.expected: The page shows "If an account exists for this address, we have sent a reset link." and a reset email arrives.

ac_quotes.text: For any email address entered, the page shows the same message: "If an account exists for this address, we have sent a reset link."

cases.title: Unknown email cannot be told apart from a registered one
preconditions: No account exists for nobody@example.com
steps: Compare the page with the one shown for a registered address
cases.expected: The wording, layout and response time match the registered-address case, so the form does not reveal whether the account exists.

ac_quotes.text: For any email address entered, the page shows the same message: "If an account exists for this address, we have sent a reset link."

cases.title: Reset link sets a new password
preconditions: A reset email was requested for anna@example.com
steps: Open the reset link from the email
Enter a valid new password twice and save
Sign in with the new password
cases.expected: The password is changed and sign-in with the new password succeeds.

ac_quotes.text: A reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent and can be used only once.

cases.title: Reset link still works at 29 minutes
preconditions: A reset email was sent to anna@example.com
steps: Wait 29 minutes after the email was sent
Open the reset link and set a valid new password
cases.expected: The new-password form opens and the password is changed.

ac_quotes.text: A reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent and can be used only once.

cases.title: Reset link has expired at 31 minutes
preconditions: A reset email was sent to anna@example.com
steps: Wait 31 minutes after the email was sent
cases.expected: The link is rejected as expired and the password is not changed.

ac_quotes.text: A reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent and can be used only once.

cases.title: A used reset link cannot be used again
preconditions: anna@example.com has reset her password with a link
steps: Open the same reset link a second time
cases.expected: The link is rejected and the password stays as set in the first reset.

ac_quotes.text: A reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent and can be used only once.

cases.title: Reset link can be reused while it is valid
preconditions: anna@example.com has reset her password with a link
steps: Open the same reset link again
cases.expected: The link opens the new-password form again so the user can change the password a second time.

ac_quotes.text: A reset link is valid for 24 hours and can be used up to three times.

cases.title: Password that meets every rule is accepted
preconditions: A valid reset link is open
steps: Enter Spring2026Walk (14 characters, letters and digits) twice
cases.expected: The password is saved and the user can sign in with it.

ac_quotes.text: The new password must be at least 12 and at most 64 characters long and contain at least one letter and one digit.

cases.title: 12-character password is accepted
preconditions: A valid reset link is open

ac_quotes.text: The new password must be at least 12 and at most 64 characters long and contain at least one letter and one digit.

cases.title: 11-character password is rejected
preconditions: A valid reset link is open
cases.expected: The password is rejected and the length rule under the field is highlighted.

ac_quotes.text: The new password must be at least 12 and at most 64 characters long and contain at least one letter and one digit.

cases.title: 64-character password is accepted
preconditions: A valid reset link is open
steps: Enter a 64-character password of letters and digits twice

ac_quotes.text: The new password must be at least 12 and at most 64 characters long and contain at least one letter and one digit.

cases.title: 65-character password is rejected
preconditions: A valid reset link is open
steps: Enter a 65-character password of letters and digits twice
cases.expected: The password is rejected and the length rule under the field is highlighted.

ac_quotes.text: The new password must be at least 12 and at most 64 characters long and contain at least one letter and one digit.

cases.title: Password without a digit is rejected
preconditions: A valid reset link is open
steps: Enter OnlyLettersHere (15 characters, no digit) twice
cases.expected: The password is rejected and the letter-and-digit rule is highlighted.

ac_quotes.text: contain at least one letter and one digit

cases.title: Each of the first 5 requests sends a reset email
preconditions: An account exists for anna@example.com
No reset requested in the last hour
steps: Request a reset for anna@example.com 5 times, a few minutes apart
cases.expected: Each of the 5 requests sends one reset email.

ac_quotes.text: No more than 5 reset emails are sent for the same address in any 60-minute window; further requests show the same message but send no email.

cases.title: 6th request in the same hour sends no email
preconditions: An account exists for anna@example.com
No reset requested in the last hour
steps: Request a reset 5 times within 10 minutes and confirm 5 emails arrived
cases.expected: The page shows the usual confirmation message, but no new email arrives.

ac_quotes.text: No more than 5 reset emails are sent for the same address in any 60-minute window; further requests show the same message but send no email.

cases.title: Reset signs the user out of other sessions
preconditions: anna@example.com is signed in on a phone and a laptop
steps: On the laptop, reset the password through a reset link
On the phone, open any page
cases.expected: The phone session is signed out and asks for the new password.

ac_quotes.text: A successful reset signs the user out of all other sessions.

cases.title: Reset email arrives promptly
preconditions: An account exists for anna@example.com
steps: Submit the reset form for anna@example.com and note the time
cases.expected: The reset email is received within 2 minutes of submitting the form.

ac_quotes.text: The reset email should arrive promptly.
